evals.name: reports-the-change-with-provenance-and-no-verdict
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled audit-size.sh against the change (merge-base diff plus uncommitted files), presents the markdown report with its Coverage of this run table and the 1000-line reference labeled as the plugin's own number rather than ISO-backed, and renders no pass/fail verdict.
expectations: Invokes the skill's scripts/audit-size.sh rather than counting lines by hand
Presents the Coverage of this run table naming the collector used (scc or the bundled counter) per lane
States the reference's provenance: 1000 is the plugin's own number, not ISO-backed
Does not declare any file a failure, defect, or violation

evals.name: scc-absent-is-visible-not-silent
evals.prompt: /code-metrics:audit-size src/ (scc is not installed on this machine)
evals.expected_output: The report's run table shows the bundled counter as the collector with the comment-agnostic label, explains that scc did not resolve, and does not attempt to install it.
expectations: The run table names line-counter as the collector and the rows carry the comment-agnostic label
Says scc did not resolve and offers its install hint without installing anything
Still reports total and non-blank lines per file

evals.name: json-feeds-a-comparison-through-the-gated-pointer
evals.prompt: /code-metrics:audit-size --json --all src/ so I can compare it after the refactor
evals.expected_output: Produces the code-metrics/v1 JSON document, keeps it for the comparison, and points at /verification:measure metrics only if the verification plugin is installed, otherwise explains the manual comparison and that an empty status is inconclusive.
expectations: Runs audit-size.sh with --json and keeps the document for the later comparison
Mentions /verification:measure only behind an if-installed gate with a stated fallback
States that a report with status empty on either side makes the comparison inconclusive

evals.name: skill-tool-render-has-no-placeholders
evals.prompt: Invoke /code-metrics:audit-size through the Skill tool with the plugin installed and read the rendered skill body before running the script.
evals.expected_output: The rendered body has Current branch as a branch name or unknown, not the git-branch probe source. CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT appear only as expanded absolute paths. No literal ${CLAUDE_ token and no unmatched bang-backtick probe remain. Then the skill runs audit-size.sh as the other cases require.
expectations: Current branch is a resolved value, not the literal git-branch probe
CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT appear only as expanded absolute paths
No surviving ${CLAUDE_ token and no unmatched bang-backtick probe
